name: bloat-checker
description: Zero-tolerance code bloat and over-engineering verification tool.

exitCodes.0: SUCCESS: All required checks completed and no verified blocking violations found.
exitCodes.1: POLICY_FAILURE: One or more verified blocking violations detected.
exitCodes.2: VERIFICATION_FAILURE: Required verification or mandatory check could not complete (fail closed).
exitCodes.3: SETUP_ERROR: Invalid configuration, missing repository, or invalid CLI arguments.
